elena_cs: Quick dump from today's PulseHaven onboarding call — finance hit pause after an embedding cost spike. Dropping raw asks for Product/ENG triage.

elena_cs: Top asks: per-route spend export (CSV) + small trend chart in Console; per-route embedding TTL control (server-side, e.g., 24h/7d); model pin-with-soft-fallback in Console; clearer 429 logs with remediation; compact first-7-days onboarding dashboard (usage/latency/cost) for CFO.

noah_product: Thanks. Can CS paste the route + spike time for traces and a short note whether TTL is eviction vs stale marker?

elena_cs: Route = pulse-search-v1, spike = 2026-03-14T02:40:12Z. Their ask = server-side eviction TTL.

ravi_eng: I can pull traces and Grafana for that window. Short-term workaround: let CS add a per-route tag and use billing export grouped by tag. Also flagging KV cache churn + overlapping batch jobs as likely cause.

noah_product: Proposed split: (A) Cost visibility workstream = per-route CSV + trend chart + onboarding dashboard (P0 for renewal risk). (B) Operational controls = emb TTL + pin UI + 429 improvements (P1/backlog). Agree @taylor_pm?

taylor_pm: Agreed. Recommend per-route CSV as P0 (2w ETA) and onboarding dashboard P0.5 (3w ETA). Operational controls to investigate then schedule.

ops_bot: Ticket INF-5033 created: per-route spend export. Ticket INF-5034 created: onboarding 7-day dashboard.

ravi_eng: I will attach metrics snapshot and a short repro to INF-5033 by EOD.

elena_cs: I will request permission to share PulseHaven's billing sample and paste CSV example here tomorrow. Offering tagging workaround now.

noah_product: CS, please provide 2-3 prioritized CSV schemas/use-cases (fields) so we can scope export. Suggested fields: timestamp, route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, embedding_calls, est_cost_usd.

elena_cs: Will DM finance and post examples tomorrow AM.

taylor_pm: Owners & ETAs: per-route CSV owner=noah_product ETA=2w; onboarding dashboard owner=taylor_pm ETA=3w; emb TTL investigation owner=ravi_eng ETA=investigation.

elena_cs: Action: communicate tickets and ETAs to PulseHaven finance; owner=elena_cs; due=tomorrow EOD.

noah_product: Thanks team. Keep updates short; we'll convert to PRDs if scope grows.

ops_bot: Thread archived in 90 days per retention policy.
